    The mesh data of k(Γ_A) #

    Lemma 2.7 and Proposition 2.6(1)(2) for C = k(Γ_A) in the form used by the proof of Proposition 2.10: the categorical radical of C is its positive-degree part (ScalarMeshCategory.localFamily), the right mesh maps at x are the arrows ending at x, and at a nonprojective x the sequences

    0 → C(W, τx) → ⊕_a C(W, E_a) → C(W, x) and 0 → C(x, W) → ⊕_a C(E_a, W) → C(τx, W)

    are exact, with first map given by c_{x,a} (σa); at a projective x the right mesh map is a monomorphism. Exactness is reduced to homogeneous families of paths (ARMeshExactness.lean) by the path-length grading.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

        Lemma 2.7 (lem:mesh-simple-tops): at every label X of C = k(Γ_A), projective or not, the right mesh map ⊕_a C(-, mid a) → C(-, X) (at a projective label, the initial forms of the components of rad P → P, the arrows into P) has image the radical of the representable C(-, X), and its cokernel is the simple top of C(-, X).
